title: Native CompOSE cold-slice (1D T=0) reader/writer with generic axes metadata
finding: E390-10 was audited (E390-10-STATUS_AUDIT_20261113.json) and found partially implemented: the EOS390 cold-slice production path is functionally complete, while the full general multidimensional reader (read all T x Yq cells, arbitrary Nadd) is not. This node, E390-10A, captures the cold-slice subset that is already passing; E390-10B captures the remaining full-multidim work.

in_scope: generic CompOSE table data model with axes metadata (nT, nYq, t_axis, yq_axis, t_first/last, yq_first/last, selected_iT, selected_iYq) on EOSData
1D axes parser: read eos.t and eos.yq grids; resolve the cold T=0 slice by VALUE with 0-based/1-based index-convention tolerance
explicit cold-slice selector: record the actual thermo-row labels used (selected_iT, selected_iYq)
lossless read/write round-trip for the cold-slice subset (1D table over nb, with Nadd in {0,1})
out_of_scope: reading all cells of a 2D or 3D table (multi-point T or Yq axes) -> E390-10B
real-data round-trip corpus test against staged raw_compose (blocked by E390-00) -> E390-10B

fortran_backend.data_model: eos_data_t (compose_eos_types.f90 lines 7-20): n, il, iT, iYq, inb_start, nadd, nT, nYq, t_first, t_last, yq_first, yq_last, selected_iT, selected_iYq, t_axis(:), yq_axis(:), nb(:), q(7,n), q_extra(n), iphase(n).
fortran_backend.reader: compose_eos_io.f90 read_internal_csv: lines 116-129 read eos.t/eos.yq grids and store full axes (nT=size(tv), nYq=size(yv), t_axis=tv, yq_axis=yv). Lines 130-132 enforce the single-cold-slice scope (reject multi-point T/Yq or T!=0). Lines 133-171 resolve the cold slice by VALUE with 0-based/1-based convention tolerance and record selected_iT/selected_iYq. Lines 195-198 accept the declared cold index OR declared+1 for the 1-based convention. Line 207 restricts Nadd to {0,1}.

python_dataclass.fields: nT, nYq, t_first, t_last, yq_first, yq_last, selected_iT, selected_iYq, t_axis, yq_axis, q_extra (lines 77-86). round-trip via from_internal_directory / write_internal_directory.
python_dataclass.copy: copy() propagates all axes metadata fields.

tests.skips: test_real_RG_SLY4_passes_slice_check and test_real_RG_KDE0v1_passes_slice_check skip because inputs/raw_compose is not staged (E390-00 BLOCKED_REPLACEMENT_ZIP_NOT_STAGED). These are real-data slice-check tests; the unit tests for the cold-slice convention tolerance all pass.

2_1D_axes_and_cold_slice_cell_index_pars.evidence: test_one_based_t_index_convention_passes, test_zero_based_t_index_with_one_based_thermo_rows_passes, test_zero_based_t_index_with_zero_based_thermo_rows_passes all pass; selected_iT records the resolved label.

3_explicit_slice_selector_for_eos390.evidence: cold T=0 slice resolved by VALUE (abs(tval)<=1e-12), not by literal index; selected_iT/selected_iYq recorded.

production_path_evidence.cohort_survey: All 13 reconstructed EoS in eos_generator/eos_data_normalized/ (APR, BBB, GM, GPPVA x8, RG x2) read successfully with q_extra_count (Nadd) in {0,1}. No cohort member exceeds the Nadd<=1 constraint, so the cold-slice reader does not block any current EOS390 model.
production_path_evidence.full_suite: python_frontend full suite: 91 passed, 2 skipped, no regression.

downstream_impact.M3_M6: cold-slice reader is the production input for M3-M6 reconstruction; confirmed non-blocking for the verified cohort.
downstream_impact.E390_10B: the full multidim reader (E390-10B) can layer on top of E390-10A by extending the data model without removing the cold-slice surface API.

next_node_recommendation: E390-10A resolved. E390-10B (full multidim reader) design is drafted in E390-10B-DESIGN_20261113.json; implementation is pending because it requires an EOSData model extension that must preserve the cold-slice API consumed by M3-M6.
